verdict.rationale: Lambda's On-Demand Cloud exposes a full REST API for programmatically launching/terminating GPU instances, with cloud-init for launch-time automation, confirmed live and key-gated by a runtime probe — enabling headless/CI-driven provisioning of GPU workloads without any UI interaction. Missing for 10: an official first-party CLI/SDK or CI/CD templates (only an unofficial community-built CLI/MCP server exists) and documented CI examples (e.g., GitHub Actions) from Lambda itself.
